question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 5.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1.**

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**familiar**" means well known from long or close association. (परिचित)
 
• Most students will take on leadership roles at some point, making it necessary for them to be "**familiar**" with typical challenges, solutions, or skills required.
 
• The other options: "**unequal**," "**strange**," and "**unusual**" do not fit the context appropriately.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *Most students will take on leadership roles with various degrees of responsibility and impact in their lives, hence, becoming familiar__ with typical challenges, solutions, or skills required is essential.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Unequal (असमान)**: means not equal in quantity, size, or value.
 
• **Strange (अजीब)**: means unusual or surprising; difficult to understand or explain.
 
• **Unusual (असामान्य)**: means not habitually or commonly occurring or done.
